target.description: Alternating head, torso and leg lines overloads one-level coverage. Shorten extended arms, keep fingers away from eyes, and recover hips before defending leg kicks, takedowns or wall pressure. Changing targets demands resets that can be timed.

stance.description: Lowered hips drive short punching entries and head-level changes. Shorten extended arms, keep fingers away from eyes, and recover hips before defending leg kicks, takedowns or wall pressure. Front loading slows leg withdrawal and invites rising strikes.
